components.name: Prompt template card
components.overview: An 88 × 116 prompt template tile with an image and a caption. The two source configurations are Template, captioned Sketch, and Original.
notes: Overview is a source-derived summary, not quoted documentation prose. The helper tier/parent are library organization choices.
Both source PNGs show the same blue folded artwork. The opaque foreground child image overrides the older image fill on Template's parent.
Original includes the source blue check vector. Template uses 16px image corners; Original uses 24px outer image corners.
Optional imageHash/src and onSelect props enable host composition; they are not additional Figma variant axes.

components.name: Checkmark circle
components.overview: The selected-image check indicator. Default is 28 × 28; Variant2 is 24 × 24. Both preserve the source circle, check vector and shadow.
notes: The source name Variant2 is retained without guessing a semantic name.
The icon is a noninteractive selected-state indicator. Selection belongs to the image control that contains it.
Overview is a source-derived summary, not quoted documentation prose; bin remains unassigned.

components.name: Main image footer
components.overview: The prompt overlay for a generated image: mode and aspect-ratio badges, source prompt text, an edit action, and like/dislike feedback. Two- and four-line variants define the source heights.
notes: The exact repeated/truncated four-line Figma sample is retained in FOOTER_PROMPTS.
The source background is transparent-to-black, suitable for overlaying an image.
Optional prompt/mode/aspectRatio/width and edit/feedback callbacks are host integration props; only property1 is a Figma variant axis.
Overview is a source-derived summary, not quoted documentation prose; bin remains unassigned.

components.name: Display image
components.overview: One image in the generated-image display list. Selected images add the source 30% dark overlay and CheckmarkCircle. The two aspect configurations have different source widths.
notes: The nominal 1:1 source configuration is actually 150 × 150.5 pixels; the half-pixel source height is preserved.
Standalone configuration previews retain each variant's actual source image. A host can pass imageHash/src when keeping one image across selection changes.
Overview is a source-derived summary, not quoted documentation prose; bin remains unassigned.

components.name: SERP template card
components.overview: A 200 × 200 SERP template tile with a 200 × 170 result image, a 48-pixel reference-image inset and the Product Spotlight title.
notes: This is a single component with no canonical variant properties.
Source image cropping is preserved for the main product image; the visible topmost reference fill is the teapot, not the older portrait fill beneath it.
Optional title/imageHash/referenceImageHash/src/referenceSrc/onSelect props allow reuse with real carousel content; they are not invented Figma variants.
Overview is a source-derived summary, not quoted documentation prose; bin remains unassigned.
